Fig. 19b (V8 addition). Chlorophyll targets: frozen models on the 2024-2026 TEST studies, as Figs 18 and 19. Models were fitted on TRAIN and frozen
(MODEL_FREEZE_CHL.json, SHA-256) before any TEST chlorophyll value was extracted; the TEST corpus was used before for yield and biomass
(POST_HOC_TEST_REUSE for the corpus, first use for chlorophyll). (a, b) TEST contrasts with the 95 % interval of the pre-declared ML candidate; (c, d)
RMSE in CV and on TEST. [V8 chlorophyll (2026-11-23)]
